title: Entergy Mississippi welcomes Smith-Jeuitt as senior media relations specialist
summary: Veteran communicator brings decades of strategic communications expertise to the senior media relations specialist role
body_markdown:
###


JACKSON, Miss. – Entergy Mississippi has added Tamica Smith-Jeuitt to its communications team as a senior media relations specialist supporting the company’s media and external relations strategy, including serving as a company spokesperson. A former broadcast journalist and nonprofit leader, she brings more than 20 years of media, crisis, and strategic communications experience to the role.


“As the energy landscape continues to evolve and intersect with new technology, maintaining the highest levels of integrity and transparency in our communications is essential. Tamica brings deep media relations expertise, crisis communications experience, and proven leadership that will strengthen our team,” said Leyla Goodsell, communications manager, Entergy Mississippi. “We are excited to welcome Tamica and look forward to the meaningful impact she will have on our communications efforts.”


Prior to joining Entergy Mississippi, Smith-Jeuitt spent over a decade advancing the mission and brand reputation of the American Red Cross in Mississippi. Throughout her tenure with the nonprofit, she held numerous communications, marketing, and leadership roles. Most recently, she served as the executive director of the Southwest Mississippi Chapter, where she acted as the principal spokesperson, strengthened community awareness, and led a wide range of stakeholder engagement initiatives.


Smith-Jeuitt graduated from Southern University in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, with a Bachelor of Arts degree in broadcasting. She is a member of the Public Relations Association of Mississippi, the National Association of Black Journalists, and Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated. She also serves on the advisory board for the Hinds Community College mass communication department.


**About Entergy Mississippi**


Entergy Mississippi provides electricity to approximately 459,000 customers in 45 counties. Entergy Mississippi is a subsidiary of Entergy Corporation. Entergy generates, transmits and distributes electricity to power life for more than 3 million customers through our operating companies in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas. We’re focused on keeping costs for our customers as low as possible while providing reliable energy that our communities count on. We’re also investing in growth for the future with a more resilient, cleaner energy system that includes modern natural gas, nuclear and renewable energy generation. As a nationally recognized leader in sustainability and corporate citizenship, we deliver more than $100 million in economic benefits each year to the communities we serve through philanthropy, volunteerism and advocacy. Entergy is a Fortune 500 company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, and has approximately 12,000 employees.
